issue.title: PA mode handling is wonky

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: Any unexpected behavior, until confirmed feature.

issue.body:
Or. half baked. 

We 'support' a mode called `PA` which is palette with alpha, stored in 4 bytes per pixel. (FWIW, I think this all applies to `LA` as well)

`Image.putpalette` (https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/master/PIL/Image.py#L1447) only allows for `L` or `P` images when adding a palette:

```
        if self.mode not in ("L", "P"):
            raise ValueError("illegal image mode")
```

`_imaging.c:_putpalette` Also only accepts\* `L` and `P`.  This code was in PIL:

```
    if (strcmp(self->image->mode, "L") != 0 && strcmp(self->image->mode, "P")) {
        PyErr_SetString(PyExc_ValueError, wrong_mode);
        return NULL;
```

\* or rather, it looks like it should but only actually accepts if `mode ==`P`and mode !='L'`

`TiffImagePlugin:_setup` (https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow/blob/master/PIL/TiffImagePlugin.py#L1137) only includes the palette for  `P` images. 

```
        if self.mode == "P":
            palette = [o8(b // 256) for b in self.tag_v2[COLORMAP]]
            self.palette = ImagePalette.raw("RGB;L", b"".join(palette))
```

All of this found while checking out #1597.

body: @playnet   Try converting any `PA` image to RGBA before doing anything else.  And possibly before saving as a tiff as well. I'm thinking that a Palette image just isn't going to work through libtiff at this point.
Can we distribute that image (rdf,tif) as a test image under the Pillow license?

issue.title: Libtiff metadata writing fixes
issue.body:
Fixes #1765, #1147, #1597 (among others, likely)

Libtiff's metadata support is tricky and dangerous. This patch is 1/3 of the work to clean up our support for it. 

1) Understand and support writing basic metadata through libtiff. This includes casting numbers to the correct format and passing in arrays correctly for known items. (e.g., this fixes #1765, writing ints to dpi, and writing the colormap for `P` mode images)

2) Consider supporting custom metadata tags safely. This is going to require reflection from libtiff to ensure that we're setting items correctly.

3) Coordinate this work with the python metadata implementation in two places: When reading images where the type conflicts with the spec, and when writing (in python) metadata of incorrect types. 

While this is not finished, I believe that this is a material improvement in the support for tiff metadata, and can be merged (after I'm happy and rebased out some things)  for 3.5.

body: Just as a summary - the segfault is resolved by #1620, correctly saving custom tag 318 is likely to be connected to #660, and converting the image is #1600.
Thanks, closing. Can re-open if not covered by those.
So my thinking was that #660 was about int custom tags, and so was resolved by #3350, while #2745 was about string custom tags. I see now that the custom tag in this issue is a tuple.
#9241 means that Pillow 12.0.0 will now save the 318 tag by default, as in the rdf.zip code from the beginning of this issue.
